ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ عَدَدَ تَسْبِيْحِ الْأَمْلَاكِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, `Adada tasbīḥi ‘l-amlāk.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the number of Angels' glorification of Allah!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ بَطَلِ الْأَبْطَالِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Baṭali ‘l-abṭāl.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the most heroic of heroes!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ مَعْدِنِ الْجُوْدِ وَ النَّوَالِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ma`dini ‘l-jūdi wa ‘n-nawāl.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the source of generosity and benefit!.
